whyMatters.heading: Why a Regular Cleaner Makes Life Easier
body: Dust, grease and limescale build up quickly in a busy home. A regular clean deals with them little and often, so they never become a big job — and your home feels ready for visitors every day of the week.

Most of our regular customers tell us the biggest difference is time: no more spending evenings and weekends catching up on housework. Booking a weekly or fortnightly house cleaner hands that job to someone who does it every day.
Because every visit follows the same checklist, nothing gets forgotten. And if you ever need more, you can add extras like oven cleaning or a one-off deep clean when you book.

how.h2: How does regular house cleaning in Manchester work?
how.intro: Setting up regular house cleaning with Cleaniq Services takes a few minutes. You tell us how often you'd like a cleaner, which day suits you and how long each visit should last, and we take care of the rest. Every visit follows our regular house cleaning checklist, so the standard stays the same week after week, and you can add extras such as oven cleaning when your home needs a little more. If you ever need to change a visit, just let us know. Here is how it works, step by step:

benefits.h2: Benefits of regular house cleaning in Manchester
benefits.intro: A regular cleaner does more than keep your home tidy. Cleaning little and often stops dust, grease and limescale from building up, which keeps your home healthier for you, your family and your pets, and makes every visit go further. It also takes away one of the biggest sources of weekly stress: housework that never seems to end. Here are the main benefits our regular house cleaning customers in Manchester tell us about:

items.body: No more spending evenings and weekends catching up on cleaning. Your house cleaner looks after it while you get on with your life.

compare.h2: Regular house cleaning or a deep clean: what's the difference?
compare.intro: Most homes need both at some point. A deep clean gets your home to a high standard, and regular house cleaning keeps it there.

cards.title: Regular house cleaning
cards.body: Visits every week, fortnight or month. Your cleaner keeps on top of the everyday jobs: kitchen surfaces and the outside of appliances, bathrooms, dusting, vacuuming, mopping and bins, following our regular house cleaning checklist.

cards.title: Deep clean

tips.label: Tips
tips.h2: Tips for getting the most from your regular cleaner
tips.intro: A few simple habits help your house cleaner get more done in the time you've booked, and keep your home looking its best between visits:
tips: Tidy away clutter, toys and clothes before your cleaner arrives, so they can spend their time cleaning rather than tidying.
Leave a short note about anything you'd like your cleaner to focus on this visit.
Tell us how your cleaner can get in if you won't be home, for example a key or entry code.
Leave fresh bed linen out if you'd like your beds changed.
Choose enough hours for the size of your home, especially for the first few visits.
Add an oven clean or a deep clean every few months for the jobs a regular visit doesn't cover.
Tell us within 48 hours if anything wasn't right, so we can put it right quickly.

faqs.q: How much does regular house cleaning cost in Manchester?
faqs.a: Regular house cleaning is charged by the hour. The current rate is shown at the top of this page and comes straight from our booking system. You choose how many hours each visit lasts when you book.

faqs.q: How often can I book a regular cleaner?
faqs.a: Weekly, fortnightly or monthly. Choose the frequency, day and arrival time when you book, and your future visits are scheduled for you.

faqs.q: Do I need to be home while the house cleaner is there?
faqs.a: No. Many customers leave a key or entry code — just add access notes when you book.

faqs.q: Do your cleaners bring cleaning products?
faqs.a: You choose: use your own supplies, or we bring eco-friendly cleaning products and equipment for £10 per visit.

faqs.q: What if I'm not happy with a clean?
faqs.a: Tell us within 48 hours and we'll send a cleaner back to re-clean anything that wasn't right, free of charge.

faqs.q: Where do you have house cleaners near me?
faqs.a: We clean homes across Manchester and Greater Manchester, including Manchester City Centre, Salford, Trafford, Stockport, Didsbury, Chorlton, Bolton, Bury, Oldham, Rochdale, Tameside and Wigan.

faqs.q: What does a regular house clean include?
faqs.a: Every regular visit covers the kitchen, bathrooms, bedrooms, living areas, stairs and hallways: surfaces wiped, the outside of appliances cleaned, toilets and bathrooms cleaned, dusting, vacuuming, mopping and bins emptied. The full regular house cleaning checklist is on this page.

faqs.q: Will I have the same cleaner every time?
faqs.a: Regular cleans have a regular cleaner, so you see the same person on each visit wherever possible.

faqs.q: When am I charged for regular cleans?
faqs.a: Each visit is charged 24 hours before it takes place, using the card you saved when you booked your first visit.

faqs.q: Can I pause or cancel my regular cleaning?
faqs.a: Yes. Contact us to pause or cancel your regular cleans. Please see our terms and conditions for notice periods and any fees.

faqs.q: How many hours do I need for each visit?
faqs.a: It depends on the size of your home and how much needs doing. You choose the number of hours when you book. If you're not sure, call us on 07846 726428 and we'll help you decide.

faqs.q: Do you clean homes with pets?
faqs.a: Yes. Just let us know about any pets when you book, so your cleaner knows what to expect.
